title: Economics execution wiring
changes: Backtester now consumes canonical configured production CostSpec when non-zero economics are configured.
Explicit zero-cost settings preserve the legacy zero-cost baseline and hand-authored order cost passthrough.
Explicit Backtester cost_spec continues to override the default authority.
notes: This wires existing cost math; it does not invent venue fees, funding, slippage, or claim realistic economics.
